metadata.description: 面向 CLI agent 的公开通用 skills。

plugins.name: workflow-hub
plugins.description: 总工作流开放能力图谱：把 Idea、共创、Goal/Task 开发、PR、产品交付、复盘与叙事连接成可验收闭环。

plugins.name: linear-board
plugins.description: TIA Idea Inbox 与 Global Goal Status Board：收集想法、提升 Goal、同步状态与 Task checklist。

plugins.name: retro-loop
plugins.description: 双路复盘与三道物理锁：把 Telemetry/Crash 与 Workflow/PR/Infra 证据转成可验收 Task。

plugins.name: story-craft
plugins.description: 四元素叙事素材抽取、脱敏与 Story Series/Tech Blog/Deck 发布读回。

plugins.name: team-lead
plugins.description: 进行任何开发、架构或规格规划、UI/UX 设计或界面重设计、数据/指标或代码库调研、实现、Bug 修复、代码审查或 PR 交付前必须加载；按单任务或多任务 Goal 通过 1-Hop 子代理编排 Explorer -> Designer -> Writer -> Reviewer -> pr_monitor。

plugins.name: m2-dispatcher
plugins.description: M2-Dispatcher（常驻域主 Bot、Cindy 与交互式 CLI 入口）编排后台 Herdr Goal Steering (TL) 的生命周期合同：开 TL、热追加、巡检解卡与 Goal/Task 完结回收。

plugins.name: personal-m2-assistant
plugins.description: 个人跨 M2 唯一入口：语义拆解、业务话题映射、Owner Gate 预览、按 wave 派发及安全清理旧 M2。

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Review a branch, PR, worktree, or handoff against repository standards and feature intent. Use for independent two-axis review with cited findings. Not for editing code.

plugins.name: xcode-cli
plugins.description: Use for Apple-platform builds, tests, simulator runs, and xcresult inspection through Swift/Xcode CLI. Choose SwiftPM for package-only changes; escalate to xcodebuild for app integration. Not for Xcode GUI automation.

plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: Use for deep, multi-source research with citations and adversarial verification. Break questions into subproblems, cross-check sources, grade confidence, and synthesize disagreements. Not for quick factual lookups.

plugins.name: codebase-design
plugins.description: Design deep modules and sharpen domain models: interfaces, seams, ubiquitous language, CONTEXT.md, and ADRs. Use when improving architecture or testability. Not for implementation by itself.

plugins.name: my-designer
plugins.description: Entry B of the Dual-Entry Design Flow: progressive-disclosure product design, UI modernization, and post-implementation Visual Traceback for desktop, mobile, and web.

plugins.name: design-studio
plugins.description: Entry A of the Dual-Entry Design Flow: ingest, classify, and stockpile design inspirations, measured palettes, interaction/motion patterns, and video assets.

plugins.name: skill-contract
plugins.description: Create and audit progressive-disclosure skills with four valves.
